methods.unit: whole base prompt, equal prompt weight and equal available model cells within prompt
methods.metrics: word trigram Jaccard / normalized whitespace character trigram count cosine / absolute whitespace word-count gap
methods.excess: mean of four cross-route pairs minus mean of two within-route pairs in each cell
methods.interpretation: surface text distances, not semantic loss, causal contamination probability or equivalence test
methods.sensitivity: nine prompts with both models complete; missing cell omitted, never imputed
